scripts.free-port: node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'); try { const out = execSync('netstat -ano').toString(); out.split('\n').filter(l => l.includes(':3000 ') && l.includes('LISTENING')).forEach(l => { const pid = l.trim().split(/\s+/).pop(); if (pid && pid !== '0') execSync('taskkill /F /PID ' + pid); }); console.log('Port 3000 cleared'); } catch(e){}"
